content: The system shall allow authenticated users to apply a discount code at checkout. The discount shall reduce the order total by the percentage specified in the discount record.
A discount code may not be applied to orders with a total below $10.00.
Discount code: A string of 6–12 alphanumeric characters issued by the marketing team to reduce order price.
Document revision history: v1.0 (2025-01-10, initial draft), v1.1 (2025-03-05, added section 4).
For example, if the user has a 20% discount code and their cart totals $50, the discount reduces the total to $40.
